name: Software Engineering & Systems Role

milestones.name: Algorithmic Foundation Checkpoint
milestones.criteria: Solve 50 LeetCode-style medium problems across linear structures and BSTs.

milestones.name: Full-Stack / Systems Project Capstone
milestones.criteria: Build and deploy a containerized full-stack or systems application with CI/CD.

milestones.name: Campus Placement Mock Interview
milestones.criteria: Pass 2 timed mock technical interviews on DSA and System Design.

source: Inter IIT Tech Meet 15.0 Appendix A, Persona A

name: Higher Studies (MS/PhD & Academic Research)

milestones.name: Faculty Research Area Matching
milestones.criteria: Review 5 recent papers and initiate faculty research collaboration.

milestones.name: Undergraduate Thesis / Capstone Project
milestones.criteria: Complete literature review and submit paper draft to peer workshop.

milestones.name: Standardized Testing (GRE/GATE/TOEFL)
milestones.criteria: Complete standardized test prep timeline with target 90th percentile.

source: Inter IIT Tech Meet 15.0 Appendix A, Persona B

name: UPSC Civil Services Examination (IAS / IFS)

milestones.name: NCERT & Foundation Social Science Mastery
milestones.criteria: Master NCERT Class XI-XII Political Science & Sociology texts.

milestones.name: General Studies Optional Alignment
milestones.criteria: Complete HSS electives supporting GS Papers I, II, and III.

milestones.name: Answer Writing & Timed Mock Test
milestones.criteria: Write 20 evaluated GS essay/case study answers under timed conditions.

source: Inter IIT Tech Meet 15.0 Appendix A, Persona C

name: Venture Builder & Entrepreneurship

milestones.criteria: Conduct 30 customer discovery interviews; complete Business Model Canvas.

milestones.criteria: Launch functional MVP; pitch to institute incubator (e.g. FITT IIT Delhi).

milestones.criteria: Prepare 10-slide pitch deck, cap table model, and financial unit economics.
